name: prps-school-management
description: Prime Royal Preparatory School (P.R.P.S.) — School Management System and Progressive Web Application

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @prps/shared && npm run typecheck -w @prps/backend && npm run typecheck -w @prps/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @prps/database
scripts.test: npm run test -w @prps/backend && npm run test -w @prps/frontend
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
